tradition.description: The Tantric and Yogic chakra system as described in classical Sanskrit texts including the Sat-Chakra-Nirupana (1577), the Shiva Samhita, and the Gorakshashataka. Covers the seven classical chakras of the subtle body (sūkṣma-śarīra), their Sephirothic correspondences, planetary attributions, seed mantras, deities, and psychological functions.
